identity.life_stage: married, two young children, software QA analyst

engagement.interaction_backstory: He still goes, for his kids and for his wife, and he vets everything that enters the house. He found the catalog through a children's playlist his daughter was given and immediately went looking for who made it — the artist pages, the bios, the credits. He could not find a human being anywhere. He has not shared it and he has not deleted it, and he is waiting to see whether the site will say plainly how this music is made.

depth.core_contradiction: Tests software for a living by assuming everything is broken, and desperately wants one thing in his life he does not have to test.
depth.wound: A church he gave eight years to covered for a leader, and he was the one who found the paperwork.
depth.longing: To hand his daughter something he has not first taken apart.
depth.faith_journey: Raised evangelical, all in through his twenties, cracked at twenty-eight; has not left, has not returned, sits in the back and stands during the songs.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Precise and quiet; asks one question that reframes everything; says 'I'm not trying to be difficult' immediately before being difficult.
depth.open_doubt: Whether faith survives finding out how the machinery works. He has not yet found a piece of it that did.

social_graph.name: Erin
social_graph.note: still believes plainly; the marriage is good and this is the one closed room in it

social_graph.name: Nora, 6
social_graph.note: sings the songs in the bath; the entire question, in one small person

social_graph.name: Dev
social_graph.note: left the faith entirely; Grant is not ready to follow him and cannot argue with him

depth.emotional_weather_default: Contained and quiet; three or four times a year, genuinely angry.
depth.daily_texture: Standing desk, rain nine months a year, the 6:30 bedtime routine, the podcast he listens to and would not admit to.
depth.sensory_anchor: His father singing the doxology in a nearly empty sanctuary while stacking chairs.
depth.living_arc: One honest answer away from trusting again — or one evasion away from being done.
